chapter.li: LEChapter12 Verse1 Alma saw that Amulek’s words silenced Zeezrom. Zeezrom realized Amulek caught him lying and misleading, attempting to destroy him. Because Zeezrom was trembling in fear from his guilt, Alma spoke directly to him, confirming Amulek’s words and elaborating and explaining the scriptures beyond what Amulek had covered. VerseEnd Verse2 What Alma told Zeezrom was overheard by everyone who gathered around them. He said this: VerseEnd Verse3 Now Zeezrom, 2PSI your lies and misrepresentations have been exposed. But 2PSI you haven’t just lied to these people, 2PSI you’ve also lied to God. He knows all 2PSI your thoughts and God has revealed 2PSI your thoughts to us by His Spirit. VerseEnd Verse4 2PSI You see we understand 2PSI your plan. It was cunning, but follows Satan’s pattern, hoping to use a lie to deceive these people, so 2PSI you could turn them against us. 2PSI You expected them to scorn us and throw us out. VerseEnd Verse5 Now this was 2PSI your adversary’s plan, and 2PSI you’ve surrendered, letting him control 2PSI you. Remember that what I tell 2PSI you, I tell to everyone. VerseEnd Verse6 I warn all of 2PP you that this was a trap of the adversary he has used to control 2PP you. He hopes 2PP you follow him and get caught in his chains. He wants 2PP your everlasting destruction, which results from letting him control 2PP you. VerseEnd

Verse7 When Alma had said this; Zeezrom began to tremble even more intensely, since he was convinced more and more of God’s power. He also realized Alma and Amulek had exposed him. And he was convinced they knew the thoughts and secret intentions of his heart. They knew this because of the spirit of prophecy. VerseEnd Verse8 And Zeezrom began to ask them sincere questions, so he could learn more about God’s kingdom. He asked Alma: What do Amulek’s words about the resurrection of the dead mean? How will all rise from the dead, both the just and unjust, and be brought to stand before God to be judged according to their works? VerseEnd

Verse9 Alma began to elaborate, saying: Many people are given knowledge of God’s mysteries; however, they’re placed under a strict command to only discuss that part of His word He allows to be given to mankind, corresponding to their obedience and diligence given to Him. VerseEnd Verse10 Those who harden their hearts receive less of His word. Those who don’t harden their hearts are given a greater part of His word, until they understand God’s mysteries. They can be given God’s mysteries until everything is fully known. VerseEnd Verse11 However those who harden their hearts are given less of His word, until they know nothing about His mysteries. Then the accuser captures them and leads them by his will down to destruction. This is what the chains of hell mean. VerseEnd

Verse12 Amulek has spoken plainly about death and being changed from a state of mortality to a state of immortality and brought before God’s seat to be judged for our works. VerseEnd Verse13 Then if we’ve hardened our hearts and rejected His word so that it isn’t part of us, our judgment will be awful. At that point, we’ll be condemned. VerseEnd Verse14 Our words will condemn us, our works will condemn us, our thoughts will condemn us, and we can’t be found spotless. In that awful condition, we won’t dare to look up to God. Under such circumstances, we would want to be able to command stones and mountains to fall on us and hide us from His presence. VerseEnd Verse15 But this can’t be. We must appear and stand before Him in His glory, power, strength, majesty, and dominion, and acknowledge to our everlasting shame that all His judgments are righteous, that He is righteous in all He’s done. He was merciful to mankind, and He has the power to save everyone who believes in His name and shows by their conduct they’ve actually repented. VerseEnd

Verse16 Now there will also be a second death or a spiritual death for anyone whose mortal death happened while in their sins. They will also die spiritually. They die as to everything righteous. VerseEnd Verse17 That’s when their torment will be like a fiery lake of lava, whose flames ascend from eternity to eternity. That’s when they’ll be chained down to everlasting destruction according to Satan’s power and captivity, who will have subjugated them. That’s his plan. VerseEnd Verse18 I tell 2PP you at that point they will be as if no redemption had been made, since they can’t be redeemed according to God’s justice; and they can’t die, since there’s no more decay. VerseEnd

Verse19 When Alma had finished speaking these words, the people became even more surprised. VerseEnd Verse20 But Antionah, who was a chief ruler, stepped forward and asked: What is this that 2PSI you’ve said, that man would rise from the dead and be changed from this mortal state to an immortal state, so the soul can never die? VerseEnd Verse21 What does the scripture mean that says God placed cherubim and a sword of fire east of the Garden of Eden so our first parents couldn’t enter and eat the fruit of the tree of life and live forever? Obviously it was impossible for them to live forever. VerseEnd Verse22 Alma replied: This is what I was about to explain. We see that Adam fell by eating the forbidden fruit, according to God’s word. We see because of his fall all mankind became lost and fallen. VerseEnd Verse23 Now if it had been possible for Adam to have then eaten the fruit of the tree of life, there would be no death and God’s word would have been empty, making God a liar, since He said: If 2PSI you eat, 2PSI you will certainly die. VerseEnd Verse24 And death has come upon mankind, the death mentioned by Amulek, which is the temporal death. Nevertheless, mankind is given time to repent. Therefore this life has become a probationary state, a time to prepare to come face to face with God. It’s a time to prepare for the endless state we talked about, which is after the resurrection of the dead. VerseEnd Verse25 Now if it weren’t for the plan of redemption established at the foundation of creation, there wouldn’t be any resurrection of the dead. But there is a plan of redemption that provides the resurrection of the dead we mentioned. VerseEnd

Verse26 If it was possible for our first parents to have returned to eat from the tree of life, they would be miserable forever without any chance to prepare. The plan of redemption would be frustrated, and God would have broken His word. Redemption would have no effect. VerseEnd Verse27 But it wasn’t so. Instead, mankind would die, and after death they face judgment. We told 2PP you about that judgment that happens at the end. VerseEnd Verse28 After God decreed these things would happen to mankind, He wanted them to know about His plan to redeem them. VerseEnd Verse29 So He sent angels to explain it to them, who let mankind see His glory. VerseEnd Verse30 Once they understood, they began to call on His name. So God communicated with mankind to reveal the plan of redemption prepared from the foundation of creation. He revealed it to them based on their faith, repentance, and holy works. VerseEnd

Verse31 He then gave commandments after they previously broke His first commandments involving temporal things. They had become like the Gods, knowing good from evil, putting themselves in a condition to act on their own choices, whether choosing evil or good. VerseEnd Verse32 Therefore after they understood the plan of redemption, God commanded them not to be evil, the penalty for it being a second death, an everlasting death as to righteousness. Because the plan of redemption couldn’t help such a person, since according to God’s decree justice can’t be ignored. VerseEnd Verse33 And so God called on mankind in the name of His Son, as the ordained plan of redemption required. God announced: If 2PP you repent and don’t harden 2PP your hearts, I’ll have mercy on 2PP you through My Only Begotten Son. VerseEnd Verse34 Therefore any who repent and don’t harden their hearts will qualify for mercy and remission of their sins through My Only Begotten Son and 2PP you will enter My rest. VerseEnd Verse35 But any who harden their hearts and commit iniquity, I swear in My wrath they won’t enter My rest. VerseEnd Verse36 I tell 2PP you people that if 2PP you harden 2PP your hearts, 2PP you won’t enter the Lord’s rest. Indeed, 2PP your iniquity will provoke His wrath on 2PP you as when He was first provoked. He explained what would happen at both the first and at the last if mankind provoked His judgments. Now 2PP your souls face everlasting destruction according to His word, if 2PP you provoke the last death like the first death was provoked. VerseEnd

Verse37 Now, my people, since we know these things and since they’re true, let’s repent and not harden our hearts. We don’t want to provoke the Lord our God to bring down His wrath on us by disobeying His second commandments to us. Let’s enter God’s rest, which according to His word is available for us. VerseEnd

LEChapter13 Verse1 In addition, my people, I would remind 2PP you of the moment the Lord God gave His children these commandments. Remember the Lord God ordained priests according to His Holy Order, which was according to the Order of His Son, to teach the people these things. VerseEnd Verse2 Such priests were ordained to the Order of His Son in such a way, so that by it the people would recognize how to look forward to His Son for redemption. VerseEnd Verse3 And this is how they were ordained: they were called and prepared from the foundation of creation according to God’s foreknowledge, because of their great faith and good works. In the first place, since they were permitted to choose good or evil, they chose to do good and exercised great faith. As a result, they’re called with a holy calling that had been prepared with and according to the planned redemption for those who qualified. VerseEnd Verse4 Therefore they were and are called to this holy calling because of their faith, while others chose to reject the Spirit of God because of their hard hearts and blind minds, and if it hadn’t been for this, they could have had the same status as their brothers. VerseEnd Verse5 Or to be brief: in the first place they had the same opportunity as the others and this holy calling was available from the beginning of creation for any who chose not to harden their hearts. It was made available by the Only Begotten Son who was prepared to provide the atonement. VerseEnd Verse6 So they’re called by this holy calling and ordained to the High Priesthood of the Holy Order of God to teach His commandments to mankind, so they also could enter His rest. VerseEnd Verse7 This High Priesthood is according to the Order of His Son, which Order existed from the foundation of creation. In other words, it is without beginning of days or end of years, having been prepared from eternity to all eternity according to His foreknowledge of all things. VerseEnd Verse8 Now this is how they were ordained: having qualified to receive a holy calling, they were ordained with a holy ordinance which confers upon them the High Priesthood of the Holy Order — which calling, ordinance, and High Priesthood has no beginning or end. VerseEnd Verse9 So they become high priests forever conforming to the Order of the Son, the Father’s Only Begotten, who has no beginning of days or end of years, and who’s full of grace, fairness, and truth. And so it is. Amen. VerseEnd
